stories.title: From Lonavala to Asangaon: Unwind with these three unique trips around Mumbai this weekend
stories.summary: Round up your gang and hit the road to Lonavala in a camping van, with scenic drives and outdoor fun along the way, apart from these other weekend getaways

stories.title: New festival will celebrate the beauty of 8mm films, in Mumbai this December
stories.summary: The recent trend of recreating the 1980s retro nostalgia using AI (Artificial Intelligence) pointed to something far deeper. It reflected a need to return to a time that was not curated for an audience. It is such films and images that are slowly making their way to the Film Heritage Foundation’s labs in Mumbai.

stories.title: Tamannaah Bhatia Graces Juhu Beach To Celebrate Chhat Puja In Dreamy Yellow Anarkali Ensemble
stories.summary: @Tamannaah Bhatia Actor Tamannaah Bhatia joined devotees at Juhu Beach in Mumbai to celebrate Chhath Puja, embracing the festive spirit with warmth and devotion. The actor interacted with people, participated in the celebrations and shared glimpses from the occasion on Instagram, where she received love and affection from those present.

stories.title: Delhi Metro services to start 2 hours early on Monday for Chhath Puja devotees
stories.summary: 30 am on Monday, two hours earlier than its usual schedule, to facilitate the movement of devotees observing Usha Arghya during Chhath Puja. The early services have been arranged for Monday, when devotees will offer Usha Arghya, the morning prayers to the rising Sun, as part of the four-day Chhath festival , DMRC said in a post on X.

stories.title: Tamannaah Bhatia joins Chhath Puja celebrations in Mumbai, shares video after The Vvaan's festive sequence won hearts
stories.summary: Actor Tamannaah Bhatia recently joined devotees at Chhath Puja celebrations in Mumbai. The actor took to Instagram to share a video from the celebrations, in which she was seen interacting with fans and taking part in the festivities. Tamannaah recently featured in The Vvaan: Force of the Forrest, and the film's Chhath Puja sequence received much love from audiences.

stories.title: Chhath Puja In Japan: Bihari Family Performs Rituals In Tokyo, Offers Arghya To Rising Sun; Videos Go Viral
stories.summary: Thousands of miles away from Bihar, a family from the state brought the spirit of Chhath Puja to Tokyo, Japan, observing the four-day festival with traditional rituals and prayers. Videos of the celebration, showing family members offering Arghya to the rising Sun and singing Chhath songs, have gone viral on social media.

stories.title: Chhath Puja 2026 In Indore Sees Thousands Offer Arghya To Setting Sun At Over 150 Locations Across City
stories.summary: FP photo Indore (Madhya Pradesh): The golden glow of the setting Sun, hundreds of devotees standing waist-deep in water, traditional bamboo baskets filled with offerings and the soulful strains of Chhath folk songs transformed Indore's water bodies into vibrant centres of faith on Sunday evening.

stories.title: 22-year-old man drowns at Dombivali pond while celebrating Chhath Puja
stories.summary: A 22-year-old man drowned in Dawadi Talao in Dombivali on Sunday evening while celebrating Chhath Puja with his siblings. The deceased, Jugunu Kashyap, a resident of Dombivali East, jumped into the pond around 6 pm despite his siblings warning him against it. His body was yet to be recovered till the time of going to press.

stories.title: Chhath Puja Sandhya Arghya Muhurat Today: Check Sunset Timings In Mumbai And Other Cities, Check Complete
stories.summary: Chhath Puja is approaching one of its most important moments as devotees prepare to gather near rivers, ponds and other water bodies to worship the setting Sun. The evening ritual, known as Sandhya Arghya, holds a special place in the four-day festival, with families coming together to offer prayers and seek blessings for their loved ones.

stories.title: 20-Year-Old Youth Goes Missing In Dawdi Pond During Chhath Puja Rituals; Fire Brigade Launches Search
stories.summary: Dombivli: A Chhath Puja celebration turned into a nightmare for a family in Dombivli after a 20-year-old youth went missing in the waters of Dawdi pond on Sunday. The youth, identified as Jugnoo Kashyap (20), reportedly entered the pond during the religious rituals but got submerged after failing to gauge the depth of the water.

stories.title: Chhath Puja Usha Arghya 2026: Check City-Wise Sunrise Timings In Mumbai, Delhi, Patna And More To Break
stories.summary: After four days of prayers, fasting and devotion, Chhath Puja reaches its conclusion with the first rays of the Sun on Monday, November 16. The final ritual, known as Usha Arghya, brings devotees together at riverbanks, ponds and other water bodies to offer prayers to the rising Sun.

stories.title: Kal Bhairav Temple Road In MPs Ujjain To Close From November 16 Evening, VIP Darshan Suspended Ahead Of
stories.summary: FP photo Ujjain (Madhya Pradesh): Preparations have begun to improve facilities for the large number of devotees expected at Shri Kal Bhairav Temple during Simhastha 2028. Collector Raushan Kumar Singh inspected the temple premises and surrounding arrangements on Sunday and issued directions to officials.

stories.title: CIAL sets up facilitation centre for Sabarimala pilgrims
stories.summary: Cochin International Airport Limited (CIAL) has set up a dedicated pilgrim facilitation centre at the airport for Sabarimala pilgrims. D. Satheesan will inaugurate the centre on November 17. Spread across 5,000 sq. , the centre is located near the police aid post, adjacent to the domestic arrival terminal and will remain open round the clock.

stories.title: Sabarimala sets target of 75 pilgrims a minute on holy steps
stories.summary: As many as 75 pilgrims are expected to climb the 18 holy steps to the Sabarimala shrine every minute under a new crowd management target set by the authorities for the annual pilgrimage season, which kicks off on Tuesday. Devaswom Minister K. Muraleedharan said the police had been given necessary directions to achieve the target.

stories.title: Yogi performs Chhath rituals, says Uttar Pradesh has moved from ‘upadrav to utsav’ | Hindustan Times
stories.summary: Chief minister Yogi Adityanath on Sunday asserted that the state had moved from an atmosphere of “upadrav to utsav” (disorder to celebrations) under the BJP government. Adityanath, who offered Sandhya Arghya to the setting sun at the Chhath ghat at Laxman Mela ground, was addressing a gathering at the venue on the Gomti riverbank.

stories.title: Palghar devotees break lake gate lock after authorities ban Chhath Puja
stories.summary: A group of devotees, mostly women, allegedly broke the lock on the entrance gate of a lake in Maharashtra's Palghar district after authorities prohibited Chhath Puja celebrations at the site, police said on Sunday. The incident occurred on Saturday evening at Nagela lake in the Gala Nagar area of Nalasopara, where authorities had barred devotees from performing the festival rituals and locked the main entrance to enforce the restriction.

stories.title: VHP To Train One Crore Hindu Families In Panchopachar Puja Across India; Over Two Lakh Families Targeted In
stories.summary: AI Mumbai: The Vishwa Hindu Parishad (VHP) plans to teach daily Panchopachar Puja to one crore families across India as part of the birth centenary celebrations of its former General Secretary, Ashok Singhal, who led the organisation for over 20 years.

stories.title: Ganga turns crystal clear near Haridwar after 150 tonnes of waste removed ahead of 2027 Ardh Kumbh, video
stories.summary: If you have scrolled through social media lately, you might have come across a viral video of the Ganga in Haridwar looking almost unrecognizable, clear enough to spot stone tiles resting on the riverbed and small fish darting beneath the surface. For anyone used to seeing murky water and floating debris around busy pilgrimage spots, the clip offered a welcome surprise.

stories.title: PHOTOS: Pune Devotees Celebrate Chhath Puja At Jambhulwadi Lake, Offer Prayers To Setting Sun
stories.summary: Anand Chaini Pune: Jambhulwadi Lake in Katraj witnessed a vibrant display of faith and devotion on Sunday evening as devotees gathered to celebrate Chhath Puja. Women dressed in colourful traditional sarees stood knee-deep in the water, holding bamboo baskets and plates filled with fruits, flowers and other offerings as they offered prayers to the setting Sun.

stories.title: What Is Usha Arghaya? Dos And Dont's To Follow On The Fourth Day Of Chhath Mahaparv
stories.summary: Puja is a four-day festival marked by fasting, holy bathing, a disciplined lifestyle, purity of mind and body, and deep devotion. The fourth day of the sacred festival is dedicated to Usha Arghya, which marks the conclusion of the four-day celebrations. On the final day, devotees gather before dawn to offer Usha Arghya to the rising Sun.

stories.title: Bank holiday for Chhath Puja on November 16? Check state-wise list of closures for November 2026
stories.summary: As Chhath Puja celebrations continues till November 16, people planning bank visits around the festival may want to check the holiday calendar before heading out. According to the Reserve Bank of India's (RBI) November holiday calendar, banks in Patna and Ranchi will remain closed on Monday, November 16 for Chhath Puja.

stories.title: Akshara Singh Offers Prayers At Dighas Minar Ghat On Chhath Puja, Shares Video Of Preparing Prasad On Clay
stories.summary: Bhojpuri actress Akshara Singh celebrated Chhath Puja in a traditional manner this year. The actress offered prayers at Minar Ghat in Digha on the third day of the festival (Sunday, November 15), with a video of her performing the rituals standing in water now circulating on social media.

stories.title: ‘Sarabhai Vs Sarabhai’ fame Rajesh Kumar shares his emotional connection with Bihar and Chhath Puja
stories.summary: As the festival approaches, the actor recalled his childhood celebrations, special moments with his mother and the traditions that continue to hold a special place in his heart. Talking about his earliest memories of the festival, Rajesh recalls how every year has brought something special.

stories.title: From Karna to Sita: The legends from the Mahabharata and Ramayana associated with Chhath Puja
stories.summary: Every year, Chhath Puja brings devotees to water bodies to offer prayers to Surya Dev, the Sun God. The four-day festival is dedicated to Sun worship, and one of its most important rituals is offering arghya to both the setting and rising Sun. While the evening offering is made to the setting Sun, devotees return the next morning to pray to the rising Sun.
